settings.headline: The 2026
settings.subtitle: Six working practitioners from six disciplines. Every judge sees every entry, scores on their own, and steps aside from work they know.

settings.headline: Meet the panel
settings.subtitle: The panel changes every year. Past judges can enter again after two years.

judges.name: Clara Okonjo
judges.bio: Illustrator and teacher whose picture books are published in 14 languages.

judges.name: Henrik Vass
judges.bio: Runs a two-person studio known for festival posters and screen prints.

judges.name: Sofia Mendes
judges.bio: Has redesigned three national magazines and still prefers paper.

judges.name: Daniel Kim
judges.bio: Documentary photographer covering coastal towns and the people who stay.

judges.name: Lena Fischer
judges.bio: Designs text typefaces for newspapers and teaches type at a design academy.

judges.name: Ravi Sharma
judges.bio: Leads a public design team and mentors the student category winners.

dates.label: Round 1
dates.title: Scored alone
dates.text: Each judge scores every entry from 1 to 10 without seeing the others.

dates.label: Round 2
dates.title: Shortlist
dates.text: The panel meets for two days and agrees a shortlist for each category.

dates.label: Round 3
dates.title: Awards
dates.text: Gold, Silver and Merit in each category, then one Grand Prix.

dates.label: Ceremony
dates.title: Lisbon
dates.text: Winners are announced live and the work goes on show for a month.

settings.headline: Show them
settings.text: Enter in any of six categories, or nominate someone whose work deserves a wider room.
